Absolute Error Distributions ?

Understanding Absolute Error Distributions

These histograms aggregate the performance of the selected active search strategy across all repeats, showing the absolute physical difference between estimated values and ground-truth values:

Overall Absolute Error: Absolute frequency error of the main estimated parameter. Lower is better.
Final Center Frequency Error (fb): The absolute error of the estimated resonance center frequency ($f_b$) at the end of the run, measuring final centering accuracy.
Final Splitting Error (fc): The absolute error of the estimated resonance splitting frequency ($f_c$, due to magnetic Zeeman or hyperfine effects) at the end of the run.
Center Frequency Error at Milestone: The center frequency absolute error ($f_b$) at the exact step when the milestone stopping criteria was met (uncertainty below convergence threshold).
Splitting Error at Milestone: The splitting frequency absolute error ($f_c$) at the moment the center frequency milestone was hit, showing early-stage splitting resolution.
fb/fc Error Reduction (Milestone - Final): The reduction in error achieved by continuing active search after the center frequency milestone. Positive values indicate successful refinement from post-milestone steps.

Uncertainty Distributions ?

Understanding Uncertainty Distributions

This histogram visualizes the remaining statistical uncertainty (standard deviation) of the estimates across all repeat runs:

Overall Uncertainty: The final estimated standard deviation of parameter estimates. Lower values represent tighter confidence bounds and high posterior certainty.
